cohort: 26 women who delivered a pregnancy after midurethral sling placement
finding: This case series suggests that midurethral sling placement is safe and durable after subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Of the 25 first deliveries after MUS, 14 were cesarean sections (5 elective primary for MUS, 5 elective repeat, and 4 for fetal indications) and 11 were spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
